act_title: THE CHITTAGONG HILL-TRACTS (TARIFF AND CUSTOMS) REGULATION, 1952

sections.section_content: 1. (1) This Regulation may be calledTHE CHITTAGONG HILL-TRACTS (TARIFF AND CUSTOMS) REGULATION, 1952.(2) It shall come into force at once.

2. (1) The enactments specified in Schedule I annexed hereto shall, subject to the amendments mentioned in the fourth column thereof, apply to the Chittagong Hill-tracts.(2) The enactment specified in Schedule II annexed hereto shall, to the extent mentioned in the fourth column thereof, apply to the Chittagong Hill-tracts.

footnotes.footnote_text: 1The word "Government" was replaced, for the words "Governor" by Article 9 of theBangladesh (Adaptation of Existing Laws) Order, 1972(President's Order No. 48 of 1972).
2The word "Government" was replaced, for the words "Governor of East Bengal" by Article 9 of theBangladesh (Adaptation of Existing Laws) Order, 1972(President's Order No. 48 of 1972).
